terms.comment: For the cup, pōcillum, pōcillī n., a small cup, as in the tea entry.

phrases.latin: Pater, pōcillō ex ōllā caffeae implētō, jentāculum raptim sūmpsit
phrases.english: Dad filled a cup from the coffee pot and had a quick breakfast
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

olla.html: The later form of aula: Festus, aulās antīquī dīcēbant, quās nōs dīcimus ōllās.

sources: Lewis & Short: ōlla · Lewis & Short: pocillum
